description: Keeps the person's own LinkedIn profile link (`myLinkedin`, a linkedin.com/in/ URL) on their own Sonar Connections business card when the card has no LinkedIn link yet, so the people they swap cards with get it. Needs a personal connector token. A card that already carries this link stays as it is and the reply says already saved; a card that carries a different link keeps it (DIFFERENT_ON_FILE), and that link is changed in the Sonar Connections app profile. Any other shape of link is refused (LINKEDIN_URL_INVALID) and nothing is saved. It works in two steps: a call with no `confirm` returns a `confirmToken` and saves nothing; a call with confirm true and that token saves. It changes only the person's own card. Returns ok, `outcome` and a sentence for the person.

confirm.description: Absent on the first call, which saves nothing. true, together with confirmToken, saves the link.

confirmToken.description: The token the first call returned. Needed when confirm is true.

myLinkedin.description: The person's own LinkedIn profile link, a linkedin.com/in/ URL. Kept on their own card when the card has no LinkedIn link yet.

name: event_card_save_linkedin
title: Save my LinkedIn link
